Very impressed with how good this feels to play. From the Directional Air Dash to the Parries everything feels very crisp and great to control. The animation work on enemies is genuinely outstanding as well. Attacks are very intuitive to read and don't require you to just learn patterns by memory. The very high quality on most animations does make it noticeable when something isn't quite at the same level (the death animation when you fall in a pit for example), but I think speaks more so to how well everything else is done when something sticks out by just being 'okay'.

Besides the fact this game has no one playing it. My friend and I bought the game. We had a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ blast. The bots do try to murder you if they are the killer. They do collect resources and hoard them sometimes. This game is fun to play with friends. A dead game is only dead until people revive it. Does it need some optimization? Yeah, a bit, there is a delay in when the game announces someone dies. A mic bug that's solved by leaving the lobby and coming back. Those are my biggest issues. However, I love the look of it cause it's like those old PS2 games honestly. I've seen worse graphics. This game is fun and we bought it on a sale. Major props to the Dev who kept putting out content and bug fixes when the game slowed down. Even put out a Halloween event. I hope it comes out this year too, cause I would like to play it with my friends.

I really enjoy this game.  The fact that it's also a dynamic "screen saver" is really fun as well.  I love leaving it just playing on idle while I do other things, either on my main monitor or on my second monitor while I'm working.  It's not a complicated game, just a lovely easy flowing progression.
If anything I just wish it had some kind of lo-fi radio in the boat that you could switch on for mood music.  I can have another program running for that, but it would be cool to have it integrated into the game as well.
Either way, I really enjoyed (and continue to enjoy) this game.  Looking forward to their next projects like Eastern Winds and the hunting version (Wild n Chill) I saw for down the line.
